testimonials.name: Farhana Rahman
testimonials.quote: The kacchi here is the most honest in the city, and the room feels genuinely special. We booked the corner table for an anniversary and they remembered the occasion.

testimonials.name: Imran Chowdhury
testimonials.quote: I bring every visiting colleague here. The seekh kebab and the daal are the two things I refuse to leave without eating.

testimonials.name: Nusrat Jahan
testimonials.quote: They handled a 24-person family dinner without a single hiccup. The team called ahead to confirm dietary needs, which almost nobody does.
